rationale: The mutation score is 0.0 and not meaningful because the golden run failed. The validation report shows golden_rejected: evaluate.py rejects the correct golden submission on FR3 (regex does not match hierarchical names like 'top.lock_reg[0]') and SR2 (testbench race condition causes incorrect key loading). The analyzer confirms these are high-severity evaluator bugs. Additionally, no mutants were generated, so all requirements are untested. The evaluator must be fixed to accept the golden submission before the case can be retained.
revision_instructions: A Tester repair reproduced the identical golden rejection. Regenerate the Expert golden and case artifacts against the pinned interface; do not weaken the evaluator to accommodate a noncompliant golden.
